title: InkUp session.json (schema_version 19)
description: One recorded review Session: the full event timeline on one clock (t = ms since t0), plus references to screenshots and media. Generated from packages/core/src/session-document.ts by `pnpm schema`; do not edit by hand.

engine.description: adapter id, e.g. webspeech, scripted, whisper, deepgram, elevenlabs

local.description: true when audio never leaves the machine; null when unknown

video_off_reason.description: why the Session has no video: the picker was cancelled, getDisplayMedia is missing, or recording failed

media_deleted_at.description: set when the reviewer deleted the audio and video after an export

blob_id.description: the finalized WebM/VP8 or VP9 recording, made seekable (duration and cues)

start_offset_ms.description: recorder start, ms since t0; pauses leave no gap in the file (packages/core/src/media-time.ts)

seekable.description: true when ts-ebml wrote the duration and cues

label.description: what the reviewer picked in the screen picker, e.g. the tab title

t0.description: epoch ms of the Session clock origin

clicked_at.description: epoch ms of the Start click, before the screen picker; Start→recording latency = t0 + media.audio.start_offset_ms − clicked_at

overlay.description: 'none': no drawing possible on this page (another extension's page or chrome://); Locations there are URL + screenshot only

voice.description: false: the Session started without a microphone (no audio or transcript until `voice_on`)

scroll.description: page scroll offset (scrollX, scrollY), CSS px

shape.description: shape class; null until shape recognition (Slice 3)

color.description: the ink colour, picked at pointer-down to stand out 3:1 against the page (packages/core/src/contrast.ts); absent: the default red

stroke_ids.description: empty only for an Object Select pick (close_reason object_select) or a page_api Annotation

scroll.description: page scroll offset (scrollX, scrollY), CSS px

resolution.description: "region": nothing resolved, only bbox is meaningful

selector.description: stable CSS selector that resolves to this element on the page

text.description: visible text, whitespace-collapsed, truncated to 200 chars

classes.description: class names, generated and utility classes removed (appearance hints: a link styled .btn is a button)

coverage.description: fraction of the Annotation bbox this element covers

source.description: absent when the page reports no source (a production build, or no framework)

file.description: source file, from src/ or app/ when the path has one, e.g. src/components/Button.tsx

components.description: the components that rendered the element, nearest first; minified names left out

pick.description: index into candidates of the geometric pick

stroke_ids.description: the arrow Strokes (one, or a shaft and a V)

point.description: page coordinates of the arrow end

bbox.description: the region resolved: the mark at this end, or a small box around the point
